description: Implementation of ue_manager class managing UE contexts, including adding, removing, and scheduling UEs, with asynchronous operations and resource management.

classes.name: ue_manager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing UE contexts, including creation, deletion, and task scheduling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all UEs and GTP-U demux.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Finds a UE context by its index.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE context based on provided configuration.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a specific UE context asynchronously.

methods.name: get_next_ue_index
methods.description: Finds the next available UE index.

methods.name: schedule_ue_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task for a specific UE.

methods.name: schedule_and_wait_ue_removal
methods.description: Schedules removal of a UE and waits for completion.
